testsAdded.name: DOS-117: the 00:20 IST finalize queues one ageing rebuild per tenant, and that job re-dates a quiet shop's dues to the new business date before it sends the tenant's rollup: stored overdue, buckets, the day's snapshot and owner_summary equal the live recompute
DOS-117: on worker start the catch-up queues a rebuild only for a tenant with dues rows dated before today (pg-boss never backfills a missed 00:20) and leaves a current tenant untouched
DOS-117: an ageing rebuild job that runs on a later business date than it was queued for ages to the run-time date, never back to the queued date
DOS-117: rebuildTenantAgeing walks a tenant of more than one page (501 shops) and dates every summary row and snapshot to the new business date as the system actor

DOS-117: ageingNeedsRebuild is true while any dues row is dated before the day or the day has no snapshot (a one-shop owner rebuild does not clear it), false after the tenant-wide rebuild, and a shop added later with no posting does not re-trigger it
DOS-117: once a day carries its nightly ageing snapshot, today's rollup still takes dues from the live summary and re-running a past day keeps the closing figure it stored

- createQueue(RECEIVABLES_AGEING_REBUILD, { policy: 'stately', retryLimit: 3, retryDelay: 300, retryBackoff: true, expireInSeconds: 3600 });

problems.detail:
The new DOS-117 test is not prettier-clean at lines 1364-1371. Prettier 3.9.6 wants `await db.insert(tenants).values({ … })` on one chain instead of the split `await db\n.insert(tenants)\n.values({`. `prettier --check` fails on the committed file, so CI's backend `pnpm format:check` would fail.

This commit introduced it: the same file at ed9ee4d^ and on main formats to zero diff. The implementer's report says `pnpm format` reformatted this file, but the committed version is unformatted.

There is no behaviour impact. Fix: run `pnpm format` in backend before or at merge.

- Ran `pnpm --filter @dos/core build` and removed the stale gitignored dist ageing-rebuild.*.

  - today: 50000/10000 received, 70000/20000 expected;

- `ageing-rebuild.spec.ts`: suite failed to load with "Cannot find module './ageing-rebuild.js'". This is the plan's stated red for this file: neither function nor rebuildAgeingPage exists on the parent, so an assertion red is impossible.
- Restored with `git checkout -- .`. `git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all` showed 0 entries. Rebuilt @dos/core; dist worker.js exports the ageing functions again.

3. PASS AFTER (each file its own vitest run)
- worker reporting.test.ts: 3/3 passed. Logs: ageingQueued 1; 'ageing rebuilt'; 'ageing catch-up' then 'ageing rebuilt'; the late job rebuilt at the 00:05 fake clock.
- core ageing-rebuild.spec.ts: 2/2.

- worker outbox-coverage.test.ts (the other caller of registerReportingJobs; its idle boss returns null on send): 2/2.

4. AMENDMENTS

5. DIFF HUNT
- Tests: reporting.spec.ts has 0 removed lines, only additions, and no existing assertion was changed or weakened.
- Contracts and schema:
  - no contract, permission, schema or migration change;
  - the owner's rebuildAgeing keeps requireRole(OWNER), idempotent() and its single withTenant transaction (receivables.service.ts:1453-1480), with only the page body moved.
- Module boundaries:
  - ageing-rebuild is exported only through receivables/worker.ts (not index.ts);
  - the worker imports '@dos/core/receivables'.
- Money and state:
  - money stays integer paise;
  - no state machine is involved;
  - the worker path is idempotent by upsert.
- RLS: the worker runs as each tenant's system actor under tenantStorage.run + withTenant; activeTenantIds stays withSystem, as before this commit.
- Dates: the rebuild job ages to businessDate() at run time (T3 proves it).
- Clean-up: no frontend change and no leftover temporary or debug files.
- Sibling consumers (the 09:00 sweep, loadOutstanding, synced rows, owner_summary) all read the re-dated summary rows, as the plan states.
- Stately dedupe: an ageing rebuild completed earlier the same day (e.g. by a start-up catch-up) does not stop a later finalize queuing a second pass for that tenant-day. It is harmless because the rebuild is an idempotent upsert.
